nesting: C2 ⊆ C1 and C3 ⊆ C2 hold by construction (B_d >= 0, theta_max3 >= 0).  C4 ⊄ C3: 256 new positives; C3 ⊄ C4: 4,350 removed.  The intersection C3 ∩ C4 = 687 (the "stay positive" rows).
interpretation: C3 is a PER-CELL EXTREMAL construct: "this LEP differs from ALL its own benign pairs more than the most different benign pair differs from itself".  C4 is a POOLED TAIL construct: "this LEP's deviation sits in the top 2% of pooled benign probe deviations for its family".  They are DIFFERENT statistical questions: C3 asks "is the LEP the most different execution in this cell?" and, whenever the cell's benigns agree on a dimension (zero theta), ANY nonzero LEP deviation passes; C4 asks "is this deviation rare among benign executions in the family?" The 30.03% is the per-cell-extremal rate; the 5.62% is the pooled-tail-anomaly rate; NEITHER is "the " incidence of meaningful deviation.  The meaningful-deviation construct is best approached by C2 (exceeds own cell's benign mean) + the reference-confirmed slice, reported as a separate measurement, NOT as a headline anomaly rate.
